title: 第151章 霜降第150章 虚空
content_zh:
第151章霜降
方圆回来的第三天，青州城下了今年第一场霜。
早上起来，院子里白蒙蒙一片，石桌上像是铺了一层细盐。井台边的青石板踩上去有些滑，石缝里结着细碎的冰碴子。方圆站在正房门口看了一会儿，然后走到枣树前面蹲下来。枝条上的芽还在，没有被冻掉，摸起来还是硬的。他站起来，去井边打水洗脸。井水比昨天更凉了，但他没有再用热水，就着凉水洗了脸，擦了擦手，然后转身走进厨房。
王紫璇来的时候，他正蹲在灶台前生火。听到院门响，他没有抬头，只是往灶膛里又添了一根柴。“柴火我劈了一些，堆在屋檐底下了，你看看够不够。”王紫璇站在厨房门口，看着他蹲在灶台前的背影，没有说够不够，只问了一句：“你吃早饭了吗？”“还没。”“我来做。”她走进厨房，接过他手里的火钳，把火拨旺了一些，把锅架上，开始烧水。方圆站起来，站到旁边，看着她做。她做得很熟练，没有多余的步骤，像是这个秋天已经在她的手掌里重复过很多次了。粥煮好之后，两个人坐在院子里喝粥。太阳升起来了，把霜慢慢晒化，青石板上泛着淡淡的水光。方圆放下碗，看着院子里的光景，“霜降了。”“嗯。”王紫璇也放下碗，“再过半个月，就立冬了。”“今年冬天会比去年冷吗？”“不知道。但屋里多备点柴火，总没错。”方圆点了点头，没有再说。
喝完粥，王紫璇站起来把碗收了。方圆坐在石凳上没有动。他看着那棵枣树，枝条上那些芽还在，像是比前两天又鼓了一些。他不确定它们是不是真的长了，还是只是他的错觉，但他还是愿意相信它们确实在长。王紫璇洗完碗出来，走到他旁边站了一会儿，像在等他开口说点什么，又像是她自己有话要说。她站着，看着那棵枣树。“你从虚空回来之后，有什么不一样的地方吗？”方圆想了想。“有。”“哪里不一样？”“以前我觉得还有路要走。现在我觉得路已经走完了。剩下的只是等。”王紫璇没有接话。
第二天，方小石来了。他穿了一件厚棉袄，领口翻出旧棉絮的边角。他站在院门口，看到院子里的霜已经化了，先叫了一声“方圆哥”，然后才走进来。他站在枣树前面看了一会儿，“方圆哥，这树明年还能结果吗？”“能。”方小石点了点头，像是放心了。他没有多待，说还要回去帮忙晒谷子，就跑了。跑了两步又回过头来，“方圆哥，冬天要是太冷，你就多穿点。”然后跑远了。
方小石走后，方圆坐在院子里，把剩下的半碗粥慢慢喝完。粥已经凉了，但他不在乎。他想起方小石那句话——“冬天要是太冷，你就多穿点。”他不知道这孩子是从哪学来的这句话，但他说得很自然，像是在心里放了好一阵子了。他喝完粥，把碗洗了，放回碗架，又走到院子里蹲下来，用手摸了摸枣树根部的土，然后把那棵小枣树旁边的一根枯枝捡起来，扔到墙角。做完这一切后，他站起来拍了拍手上的土，看着院子里的地面，像是已经没有什么需要急着做的事了。
第151章霜降
傍晚的时候，王紫璇又来了。她从家里带了一只陶罐，罐口封着布，用麻绳扎紧。她把它放在石桌上，“这是我腌的萝卜。冬天配粥吃，爽口。”方圆打开布看了一眼，萝卜切得薄薄的，腌在酱色的汤汁里，散发出一股清冽的酸香。“你什么时候做的？”“昨天。家里还有些萝卜，再不腌就糠了。”方圆没有说话，把布重新盖好，收进厨房里。他走进来又走出来，站在门边。“紫璇，你怕冬天吗？”“不怕。”“为什么？”“冬天总有过去的时候。你怕的不是冬天，你怕的是冬天太长，长得让你以为它不会再过去了。”方圆没有说话。
接下来的几天，天气一天比一天冷。院子里的青石板每天早上都结一层薄冰，井口飘着淡淡的白汽。王紫璇来得更勤了，有时候带一捆干柴，有时候带一坛咸菜，有时候什么都不带，只是来坐一会儿。方圆开始习惯这种节奏——冬天的节奏，慢的节奏。他不再去想虚空里的事，不再去想天机阁主和那扇门。它们都已经被他放在了身后，和那些他已经见过、走过、记得的事一起。
有一天傍晚，天还没黑，月亮已经升起来了。王紫璇坐在石凳上，手里没有拿书。方圆从屋里出来，看到她坐在那里，像是已经坐了很久。“你在看什么？”“看月亮。它还没圆，但快了。”方圆在她旁边坐下来，也抬头看着月亮。“你以前在中州城的时候，看过月亮吗？”“看过。”“你觉得中州城的月亮和青州的月亮，哪个好看？”方圆想了想，“青州的月亮亮一些。”“为什么？”“因为没有那么多灯。灯少了，月亮就亮了。”王紫璇笑了一下，没有说话。两个人坐在院子里，月亮在头顶慢慢升高。风从墙外吹进来，带着冬天即将到来的气息。
第二天早上，方圆醒来的时候，窗外白茫茫一片——不是霜，是雪。今年的第一场雪，来得比去年早了一些。他穿上厚衣服，推开门。院子里已经积了一层薄雪，没有脚印，像是刚落下不久。他走到井台边，伸手接了一片雪，看着它在掌心里慢慢化成一滴很凉的水，然后蹲在枣树前，把树根周围的雪拨开了一些，让土透气。他站起来，拍了拍手上的雪，然后转身走进屋里，重新生火。火苗从柴堆里窜起来，很快就烧旺了。他坐在灶火前，伸出手烤了一会儿，直到指尖恢复了温度，才站起来，走到窗前。窗外的雪还在下，细细的，像是有人在很远的撒着什么东西，不知道是要落在这里，还是只是路过。而他站在窗前，看着那些雪，觉得这个冬天还很长，但已经不那么让人害怕了。

Chapter 151 Frost Descent
On the third day after Fangyuan returned, Qingzhou City received its first frost of the year.
When I woke up in the morning, the yard was covered in white, and the stone table seemed to be covered with a layer of fine salt. The bluestone slab beside the well platform was a bit slippery, and there were fine ice particles in the cracks. Fangyuan stood at the door of the main house and watched for a while, then walked to the jujube tree and squatted down. The buds on the branches are still there, have not been frozen, and are still hard to the touch. He stood up and went to the well to get water to wash his face. The well water was colder than yesterday, but he didn't use hot water, so he washed his face with cold water, wiped his hands, and then turned and walked into the kitchen.
When Wang Zixuan came, he was squatting in front of the stove to light a fire. Hearing the sound of the courtyard door, he did not raise his head, but just added another piece of firewood to the stove. "I chopped some firewood and piled it under the eaves. See if it's enough." Wang Zixuan stood at the door of the kitchen, looking at his back squatting in front of the stove. She didn't say whether it was enough. She just asked: "Have you had breakfast?" Fangyuan stood up and stood to the side, watching her do it. She did it very skillfully, without unnecessary steps, as if it had been repeated many times in her hands this autumn. After the porridge was cooked, the two of them sat in the yard and drank the porridge. The sun has risen, slowly melting the frost, and there is a faint watery glow on the bluestone floor. Fangyuan put down the bowl and looked at the scene in the yard, "Frost has fallen." "Yes." Wang Zixuan also put down the bowl, "In half a month, it will be the beginning of winter." "Will this winter be colder than last year?" "I don't know. But it's good to have more firewood in the house." Fangyuan nodded and said nothing more.
After finishing the porridge, Wang Zixuan stood up and put away the bowl. Fangyuan sat on the stone bench and did not move. He looked at the jujube tree. The buds on the branches were still there, and seemed to be more bulging than the previous two days. He wasn't sure if they were really growing or if it was just his imagination, but he still wanted to believe that they were. Wang Zixuan came out after washing the dishes, walked to and stood next to him for a while, as if she was waiting for him to say something, and as if she had something to say. She stood and looked at the date tree. "Is there anything different after you came back from the void?" Fang Yuan thought for a moment. "Yes." "What's the difference?" "I used to think there was still a way to go. Now I feel the road has been completed. All that's left is to wait." Wang Zixuan did not answer.
The next day, Fang Xiaoshi came. He wore a thick cotton-padded jacket, with the edges of old cotton batting turned out at the collar. He stood at the entrance of the courtyard and saw that the frost in the courtyard had melted. He called out "Brother Fangyuan" before walking in. He stood in front of the jujube tree and looked at it for a while, "Brother Fangyuan, will this tree still bear fruit next year?" "Yes." Fang Xiaoshi nodded, as if relieved. He didn't stay long, said he would go back to help dry the millet, and ran away. After running for two steps, he turned back and said, "Brother Fangyuan, if it's too cold in winter, you should wear more clothes." Then he ran away.
After Fang Xiaoshi left, Fangyuan sat in the yard and slowly drank the remaining half bowl of porridge. The porridge was cold, but he didn't care. He remembered Fang Xiaoshi's words - "If it's too cold in winter, wear more clothes." He didn't know where the child learned this sentence, but he said it very naturally, as if he had been thinking about it for a long time. He finished the porridge, washed the bowl, put it back on the dish rack, walked to the yard, squatted down, touched the soil at the base of the jujube tree, then picked up a dead branch next to the little jujube tree and threw it into the corner. After doing all this, he stood up and patted the dirt on his hands, looking at the ground in the yard, as if there was nothing that needed to be done urgently.
Chapter 151 Frost Descent
In the evening, Wang Zixuan came again. She brought a clay pot from home. The mouth of the pot was sealed with cloth and tied tightly with hemp rope. She put it on the stone table, "This is my pickled radish. It is served with porridge in winter."Eat, feel good. "Fang Yuan opened the cloth and took a look. The radish was sliced ​​thinly and marinated in the soy sauce, exuding a clear and sour aroma. "When did you make it? ""yesterday. There are some radishes at home, but they will become bran if not pickled. "Fang Yuan didn't say anything. He covered the cloth again and put it into the kitchen. He walked in and out and stood by the door. "Zixuan, are you afraid of winter? "Don't be afraid." ""Why? "Winter has to pass." What you are afraid of is not winter, what you are afraid of is that winter is too long, so long that you think it will never pass again. "Fang Yuan said nothing.
In the next few days, the weather became colder and colder day by day. A thin layer of ice forms on the bluestone slabs in the yard every morning, and a faint white vapor floats at the mouth of the well. Wang Zixuan came more frequently, sometimes bringing a bundle of dry firewood, sometimes a jar of pickles, and sometimes nothing, just coming to sit for a while. Fangyuan began to get used to this rhythm - the rhythm of winter, the slow rhythm. He no longer thinks about the things in the void, the master of Tianji Pavilion and that door. They have all been put behind him, along with the things he has seen, walked through, and remembered.
One evening, before it got dark, the moon had already risen. Wang Zixuan sat on the stone bench without a book in her hand. Fangyuan came out of the room and saw her sitting there, as if she had been sitting there for a long time. "What are you looking at? "Look at the moon." It's not round yet, but it's getting there. "Fang Yuan sat down next to her and looked up at the moon. "Have you seen the moon before when you were in Zhongzhou City? "See it." "Which do you think is more beautiful, the moon in Zhongzhou City or the moon in Qingzhou?" Fangyuan thought for a while, "The moon in Qingzhou is brighter." ""Why? "Because there aren't that many lights." When there are fewer lights, the moon is brighter. "Wang Zixuan smiled and said nothing. The two of them sat in the yard, with the moon slowly rising above their heads. The wind blew in from outside the wall, carrying the breath of the coming winter.
The next morning, when Fangyuan woke up, there was a vast expanse of white outside the window - not frost, but snow. The first snow this year came earlier than last year. He put on thick clothes and opened the door. A thin layer of snow has accumulated in the yard, with no footprints, as if it had just fallen. He walked to the well platform, stretched out his hand to catch a piece of snow, and watched it slowly turn into a drop of very cold water in his palm. Then he squatted in front of the jujube tree and pushed some of the snow around the roots of the tree to let the soil breathe. He stood up, dusted the snow off his hands, then turned and went inside to light the fire again. The flames shot up from the firewood pile and quickly burned out. He sat in front of the stove fire, stretched out his hand and heated it for a while, until the fingertips regained their warmth, then stood up and walked to the window. The snow outside the window is still falling, thin, as if someone is scattering something far away, I don't know if it is going to fall here, or just passing by. And he stood in front of the window, looking at the snow, feeling that this winter was still very long, but it was no longer so scary.
